hypothesis: Within predeclared compatible protocol strata, higher actual damping-group particle count may associate with lower relaxed plate pressure. Association is not a causal claim.
primary_endpoint: Pressure at the exact final/harvest frame of the downstream descriptors, conditional on a prospectively fixed relaxation-completion rule; not trace minimum, target crossing, or assumed equilibrium.
N_definition: Actual surviving damping-group particle count at the relaxed comparison frame, with phase counts and separately captured moving/stop count; planned count is a distinct field.
comparability_required: composition and PSD matched or explicitly stratified
target, plate area, speed and effective damping protocol verified
run/restart chain and phase identity bound
identical relaxed endpoint and descriptor frame conventions
independent unit and shared-seed/pair structure declared

prospective_statistics.matched: Report delta N and delta P_relaxed signs for every prespecified eligible pair; zero differences remain ties.
prospective_statistics.stratified: Descriptive slope/correlation and uncertainty only if distinct N and identifiable design permit; exact uncertainty policy frozen before access.

proposed_judgment_categories.NOT_COLLECTED: No authorized LHS values collected; current state.
proposed_judgment_categories.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Required lineage, units, phase completion, or protocol comparability missing; no association judgment.
proposed_judgment_categories.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: No usable N variation or N inseparable from composition/loading/thickness in the declared design; no independent N-effect claim.
proposed_judgment_categories.DIRECTION_CONSISTENT: For eligible predeclared matched pairs with nonzero delta N, all delta N times delta P_relaxed are negative; descriptive consistency with registered risk only.
proposed_judgment_categories.DIRECTION_MIXED_OR_TIED: Eligible matched pairs include ties or mixed signs; does not establish pressure equivalence or absence of confounding.
proposed_judgment_categories.DIRECTION_OPPOSITE: For eligible predeclared matched pairs with nonzero delta N, all delta N times delta P_relaxed are positive; contradicts directional expectation in that set, not proof of causality or equal states.

judgment_limits: No eligible pair means NOT_ESTABLISHED or NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, never vacuous DIRECTION_CONSISTENT.
Categories describe matched contrasts only; broader unmatched slopes remain descriptive and do not automatically classify cases.
Exact ties are arithmetic ties, not a noise-equivalence claim. Uncertainty unresolved means no strength/significance assertion.
All categories leave composition-only interpretation and equal-pressure claims unestablished absent separate pressure-state justification.
No existing eligibility/status/value is overwritten; no case rejected from a main handoff by this inactive draft.

mechanistic_distinction.raw_N: Count only; not a force or pressure.
mechanistic_distinction.scale_candidate: c_v*N*v_characteristic/area is a dimensional diagnostic only after coefficients, units, group and velocity definition are verified. It is not measured drag.
mechanistic_distinction.signed_force: Uniform linear external viscous fix permits -c_v*sum(v_z); otherwise sum actual applicable per-particle terms. Phase/group/mass and sign conventions must be verified.
mechanistic_distinction.denominator: Same-event measured plate force, never nominal750N; pressure uses verified area and scaling.
mechanistic_distinction.phase_warning: Moving compression, stop, first relaxation output and final/harvest frame are distinct; fixed plate does not imply zero particle velocity.

pre_access_pending_decisions: Actual original/effective deck static audit and source hashes
Exact relaxed completion and endpoint rule
Frozen compatible cohort, pair IDs, matching and exclusion rules from non-outcome metadata
Author ratification and separate existing A/C/value-access authorization
future_access_order: ratify A/C and value-access rules plus this prospective definition
missing_policy: Missing NOT_COLLECTED/null; established invalid quantities UNDEFINED/null with reason; never substitute zero or imported data.
